title: ELOTE Mexican Street Corn - Hot and Messy
body:
The authentic way to make elote. Warning: this gets messy. Very messy. The mayo drips everywhere. You will need napkins.

Ingredients:
- 4 ears of corn
- 1/2 cup mayo
- 1/2 cup crumbled cotija cheese
- 1 tbsp chili powder
- 2 limes
- Fresh cilantro
- Butter

Steps:
1. Grill corn until charred
2. Spread mayo generously
3. Roll in cotija cheese
4. Dust with chili powder
5. Squeeze lime juice
6. Garnish with cilantro
summary: The authentic way to make elote. Warning: this gets messy. Very messy.

comments.content: Professional chef here. This technique is actually spot-on. Well done.
